100 reserve rd|06810.summary: Residents at Residences at The Summit praise the fabulous property, wonderful community atmosphere, and excellent amenities that create a sanctuary-like feeling. Staff members Ashley, Alfredo, and Shana receive high marks for being friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive to requests.

reviews.name: Jacqueline Ross
reviews.body: I went to tour the new property and it is fabulous!  The staff is very friendly and engaging and the community is wonderful. You have everything you need at your fingertips and once you come home from work you feel at home in your own sanctuary. My husband and I can't wait to move in!

response.body:
We're truly grateful for your kind words and enthusiasm about our community. It's heartening to know that you and your husband are looking forward to becoming part of our family. We strive to create a welcoming and comfortable environment for all our residents. We can't wait to welcome you home!

Sincerely, 
The Residences at The Summit Management Team

reviews.name: Irina Colby
reviews.body:
I moved in to this place back in July and I couldn’t be more happier with it. The apartments itself, the building and amenities are so great, the security in the building and a convenience to have everything on the site is just amazing.
I would like to mention the management of the building The Willow Bridge and say THANK YOU to the leasing managers Ashley and Alfredo! These guys are always being so helpful and attentive to the every single request I had. Very friendly and nice people, it is always a pleasure to work with them!!!
Thank you guys and a Willow Bridge management to make our living at the Residences at Summit better!!!

response.body:
We are delighted that you're enjoying your experience with us. It's wonderful to know that our team, including Ashley and Alfredo, have been helpful and attentive to your needs. We strive to make The Residences at The Summit a great place to live. Thank you for your kind words!

Sincerely, 
The Residences at The Summit Management Team

reviews.name: joseph blount
reviews.body: Treated at the front desk by receptionist Shana. I was offered food, beverages and facilities. I was by Ms. Ashley like I was her parent, she should be doing training for leasing managers. Not only was she knowledgeable and proficiency, she was kind hearted; something rare in days world. You better keep this gem because someone else will take her. Please don’t disregard the other gentleman Alfredo. For other questions reach out to me via email. Thank You

response.body:
We truly appreciate your kind words and are thrilled to hear about your positive experience with Shana, Ashley, and Alfredo. Their dedication to providing exceptional service is indeed a valuable asset to our community. We're grateful for your recognition of their efforts. We encourage you to reach out to us directly for any further inquiries. 

Sincerely, 
The Residences at The Summit Management Team

26 belden ave|06850.summary: The Confluence at Norwalk receives praise for spacious, clean apartments with full-size washers/dryers. Residents consistently highlight exceptional maintenance team (Jairo & Ben) for quick, courteous service and leasing staff (Gia) for outstanding customer support. Amenities like the pool and building cleanliness earn positive feedback. Some note occasional elevator outages.

reviews.name: Jordan Weekes
reviews.body: The move in experience was great. Sam made the transition very seamless. I would definitely check out the building. Jairo is also very helpful and responds to any maintenance issues fast as well.

response.body:
Hello Jordan, we appreciate the fantastic 5-star rating! It’s great to know that the transition went smoothly and that our team provided prompt assistance with any maintenance issues. Your recommendation to check out the building means a lot to us.

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Brandalyn Fulton
reviews.body: This review is long overdue. Very thankful to the maintenance professionals at our apartment complex. Jairo has been extremely helpful from the moment we moved in 4 years ago. We just recently moved to a different unit and Jairo and Ben were helpful in making the transition smooth. They have a lot of responsibilities and are always timely, courteous, and communicative. Jairo has really stepped up with the managing all of the special requests that may be needed to get the job done. We are very fortunate for their commitment to keeping our property well maintained.

response.body:
Hello Brandalyn, it's truly heartwarming to hear about the exceptional service provided by Jairo and Ben at The Confluence. Your recognition of their efforts in maintaining our property is greatly appreciated.

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Anna Dietchweiler
reviews.body:
My husband and I have been living at The Confluence for over 7 months now and have had a very positive experience! The apartment is spacious and comfortable, the building is constantly being cleaned, and the amenities are convenient (the pool has been especially wonderful now that it's summer).

Maintenance has been consistently prompt to respond and I received tip top customer service when I encountered a plumbing emergency. Gia immediately picked up when I called the office, advised me on how to stop the flooding from becoming worse in real time and called maintenance, who arrived on my doorstep in under 5 minutes. Their combined help gave me peace of mind and avoided any significant damage to both my belongings and the apartment itself.

I'd recommend The Confluence to anyone who's looking for apartments in the Norwalk area - it's a great place to live!

response.body:
Hi Anna, we are delighted to hear about your positive experience at The Confluence! Your satisfaction means a lot to us. 

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Joan Pagaduan
reviews.body: Jairo and Ben from maintenance are really awesome. I sent a request in the morning for anything and they come by and fix right away. No delays.  Really awesome people! Very grateful for the work that they do!

response.body:
Hey Joan, it's fantastic to hear such positive feedback about the maintenance team! Their quick and efficient service makes a significant difference in our residents' experience. We truly value their hard work and dedication.

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Balloon Boutique USA
reviews.body: Gia Mendoza, as the Assistant Manager of The Confluence, your leadership, dedication, and organizational skills are truly admirable. You play a vital role in ensuring everything runs smoothly, and your positive energy inspires those around you. Keep up the amazing work—you’re making a real difference!

response.body:
Hi, we appreciate your positive feedback! Such feedback motivates everyone to continue making a difference!

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Talia Ordonez
reviews.body: I've been living at The Confluence for over three years now, and I can’t say enough wonderful things about this place! The maintenance team, Jairo and Ben, are truly amazing—they work so hard and always go the extra mile to keep everything running smoothly. You can really tell they take pride in what they do! The other tenants are friendly and kind, creating such a welcoming atmosphere. Plus, the management company really cares about its residents. Right now, one of the three elevators is out of service, but the management has been great about keeping us updated and is working hard to get it fixed as soon as possible. Gia in the leasing office is always so sweet and straightforward. I feel lucky to call this place my home.

response.body:
Hello Talia, we are delighted to hear about your wonderful experience at The Confluence. Your kind words about our maintenance team and the welcoming community atmosphere mean a lot to us. Thank you for being a valued resident!

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Carolina A.
reviews.body: Had an amazing experience with the leasing agent Gia. She was welcoming from the start and answered my endless questions so graciously! I fell in love with the units: gorgeous and well kept. The hallways, office area and elevators are immaculate and I can only give a positive review of my experience. Keep up the good work!!

response.body:
Hi Carolina, thank you for sharing your positive experience! We appreciate your kind words about the property and are delighted to hear that you had a great leasing experience. Your feedback is valuable to us, and we look forward to providing excellent service always.

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team

reviews.name: Laurie Stern
reviews.body: I live at The Confluence in Norwalk for 6 mo.  The apt is clean, spacious and has a  full size washer and Dryer. and good size rooms.  The apt when I rented it was so clean it looked like no one lived there before me.  Gia from the leasing office is amazing.  Always kind and will go the extra yard to make sure I was satisfied.  One day my Michelle watch went down the trash shoot. I went into the leasing office in a panic, and Gia stopped what she was doing and went to the dumpster room  and found my watch. I also want to complement the cleaning staff who are always busy cleaning the apartment building.  It’s so clean and they are always so polite and friendly.. When I needed the maintenance people, they came within a short period of time and are always there to assist me. I know finding an apartment is difficult, but it’s nice to know. I chose the right complex and I am totally satisfied.

response.body:
Hi Laurie, thank you for sharing your positive experience at The Confluence in Norwalk. We are delighted to hear that you found the apartment clean, spacious, and well-serviced. We value your feedback and are dedicated to delivering outstanding service. 

Best,
The Confluence at Norwalk Management Team
